feature_cost_scope: GPU-resident transform extraction only, including synchronization; excludes waveform transfer, classifier and generation

heldout_test.interpretation: Bounded-EMD diagnostics; good reconstruction does not demonstrate converged physical IMFs

test.interpretation: Bounded-EMD diagnostics; good reconstruction does not demonstrate converged physical IMFs

limitations: Synthetic source types are not vessel classes
Background scenes are reused across regime diagnostics; strata are not independent
AP prevalence differs across regimes; compare methods within a regime
HHT uses a bounded approximate decomposition with reported nonconvergence
Missing-view replacement is a diagnostic distribution shift, not a missingness-trained system
Feature timing excludes transfer, classifier inference, generation and language-agent cost
metric: binary clip-presence average precision from raw-logit ranking; not temporal AP

regime_definitions.chirp_dominant: single active type-1 source: swept tone plus 0.3 times harmonic component
regime_definitions.decaying_am: single active type-2 source: harmonic/AM signal with exponential event envelope; not an impulse or real vessel class
regime_definitions.harmonic_am: single active type-0 source: amplitude-modulated harmonics with bounded frequency variation
regime_definitions.overlapping_sources: two active synthetic sources, any type

scope: Fully synthetic clip-presence study; no temporal or real-field detection claim
